specs.title: callback consumes the flow before exchange, verifies the identity and only then saves a session
missing and invalid or expired flow cookies have distinct bounded classifications
mismatched and duplicate state are rejected without calling Shopify or saving a session
provider errors expose only standard OAuth enums, never provider details
token exchange status and OAuth error survive classification without response bodies
a failed identity verification never saves a session and logs only a JWT code and claim name
cookie overflow is identified after verification without exposing the session contents
unexpected errors and untrusted diagnostic fields cannot leak arbitrary strings
OAuth return locations reject external, encoded and control-character redirects
account writes require the exact configured Origin
canonical login uses the browser Host instead of a normalized Next bind address
cart and checkout accept a configured HTTPS host behind HTTP without trusting forwarded headers
PKCE uses the RFC 7636 S256 vector and cryptographically random verifier values
session cookies encrypt private data and reject tampering, a different key and purpose
malformed session values and undersized keys fail closed
discovered endpoints require public HTTPS destinations without credentials
ID tokens verify signature, issuer, audience, expiry, nonce and refreshing subject
signed Shopify numeric subjects normalize losslessly while identity safeguards remain enforced
carousel and hero controls preserve explicit false and reject unsupported values
editor URLs cannot inject protocols, credentials, controls, or unsupported images
rich text becomes readable plain text and large content is bounded
section mapping preserves editor intent while rejecting invalid optional settings
usable dyu content wins, while empty new fields preserve legacy custom data
product references and presentation controls stay within supported shapes and colors
editorial images retain fill layout and select mobile artwork without changing desktop artwork
Shopify article copy and reading time always win, including the original starter copy
merchant article headings create reader chapters and editable invitations remain independent
ingredient presentation overrides preserve product evidence and support hiding entries
four default carousel scenes remain available; hidden slides stay hidden and sorting retains their own artwork
normalized empty override fields inherit base content, while explicit false survives
merchant product references win in order, with category fallback for unavailable references
merchant and native collection images take precedence over 3D, with mobile artwork and product-image mode
the hero follows the selected category and skips unavailable sources
botanical names use the product identity before supporting ingredients
compact jars and bottles have smaller pedestals than a soap ensemble
real model proportions drive uniform scaling and pedestal bounds
invalid reconstruction measurements cannot produce invalid scene coordinates
promotional bundle artwork uses only the verified complete set of real members
a partial homepage order is deduplicated and invalid handles cannot remove sections
default sections retain their intended positions when only one sort order is saved
journal cards can be added, hidden, and explicitly ordered without accepting unrelated content
ritual editing preserves copy and image settings and removes disabled moments and steps
uploaded Shopify branding replaces the bundled image while retaining safe image dimensions
ingredient detail resolves an exact story handle before a generated name alias
generic ingredient-list words do not assert butter or French origin
generic product names do not assert more specific ingredients
fully named ingredients remain indexed with their published source
merchant ingredient stories keep their supplied identity
configuration readiness retains external payment and operational gates
preview, insecure, credentialed, path and mismatched origins cannot pass launch checks
launch check catches demo, unset indexing, weak secrets and exposed credentials without logging them
Shopify paragraphs and attributed breaks retain distinct text boundaries
unordered, ordered and paragraph-wrapped list items remain readable
entities decode once after tags, scripts and comments are removed
unknown and invalid numeric entities remain literal without crashing
missing or unusable HTML uses native plain text without parsing it as markup
long merchant description text is preserved without an implicit display cap
actual description renderer uses separate escaped pre-line paragraphs and safe fallback
uploaded making artwork works without inventing product instructions
invalid editor values retain the hero defaults and cannot inject unsafe artwork or links
hero artwork uses distinct mobile and desktop sources and the optional 3D card can be hidden
merchant wording is displayed verbatim and disabling the hero removes it
reduced motion hides autoplay controls through CSS while preserving server markup
long merchant copy stays inside the hero without overlapping the preview at 375px
long merchant copy stays inside the hero without overlapping the preview at 768px
long merchant copy stays inside the hero without overlapping the preview at 1024px
long merchant copy stays inside the hero without overlapping the preview at 1440px
profile edits permit only bounded name fields
address inputs reject unrelated customer fields and preserve country/region codes
order and cursor inputs are bounded identifiers, never arbitrary query text
wishlist merges deduplicate, removals are targeted and full lists are never silently truncated
readiness returns 503 for an empty or failed catalogue and 200 only when products load
request limits reject declared oversize before consuming the stream
chunked oversized requests are cancelled before the remaining body is buffered
JSON requests require an object, valid UTF-8, a JSON content type and a byte bound
cart changes accept only bounded IDs, quantities and implemented fields
stored wishlist data cannot silently discard malformed or excess entries during the next write
webhook authentication covers exact raw bytes and rejects malformed or forged signatures
similarity changes with the viewed product, excludes itself and ignores catalog order
generic marketing, bottle shape and a matching price do not qualify unrelated products
a matching botanical in another soap category outranks an unrelated scent in the exact category
ingredients, care purpose, merchant selections, price and availability refine recommendations
recommendations contain at most eight unique relevant items and never pad a short list
saved handles reject malformed storage, deduplicate and enforce capacity
recent views move to the front and retain only the last 24 products
only an explicitly approved production origin can be indexed
